peer_results.rationale: None of the supplied AMD candidates (amd_2024_8_D006, amd_2024_8_D029, amd_2024_8_D098) are substantively comparable to the target's disclosure on Prepaid Supply and Capacity Agreements. The target discusses $2.5 billion in prepayments for supply capacity, whereas the AMD candidates discuss the reclassification of unbilled receivables (D006, D029) or the accounting for foreign currency forward contracts (D098). These represent different financial assets (receivables vs. supply prepayments vs. derivatives) and different business drivers, making them not comparable despite sharing the same balance sheet line item 'Prepaid expenses and other current assets'.
